title: Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers — Reinstatement-Fee Source-Fare Rate
content:
**Rule 1.** The reinstatement-fee source-fare rate on a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers follows the fare brand, under Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand, of the ticket the credit arose from:

(a) 0.80 when that ticket was sold as Crestline First or Crestline Premium Economy;
(b) 0.90 when it was sold as Crestline Main Plus or Crestline Main Flexible;
(c) 1 for any other fare brand.

**Rule 2.** The ticket read is the credit's source ticket, and the fare brand is the one that ticket was sold as.

| Fare brand of the ticket the credit arose from | Source-fare rate |
|---|---|
| Crestline First | 0.80 |
| Crestline Premium Economy | 0.80 |
| Crestline Main Plus | 0.90 |
| Crestline Main Flexible | 0.90 |
| Crestline Main Cabin | 1 |
| Crestline Basic Economy | 1 |

**Hypothetical application.** A credit that arose from a ticket sold as Crestline Main Flexible carries a source-fare rate of 0.90. A credit that arose from a Crestline Basic Economy ticket carries 1.
